nodes.description: Total supply of LP tokens, updated by _mint and _burn.
Mapping of LP token balances per address.
Mapping of ERC20 allowances owner=>spender=>value.
Mapping of permit nonces per owner, incremented in permit.
EIP-712 domain separator used for permit signature verification.
Address of the factory that deployed the pair; used for authorization and feeTo lookups.
Address of the first token in the pair (sorted order).
Address of the second token in the pair (sorted order).
Cached reserve of token0 as of the last liquidity event (uint112).
Cached reserve of token1 as of the last liquidity event (uint112).
Timestamp of the last reserves update used for TWAP accumulation (uint32, overflow desired).
Cumulative price of token0 for the TWAP oracle, updated in _update.
Product of reserves as of the most recent fee-minting liquidity event.
Reentrancy lock flag toggled by the lock modifier (1 = unlocked).
Recipient address of minted protocol fees; set by feeToSetter.
Address authorized to change feeTo and feeToSetter (access control role).
Mapping token0=>token1=>pair address registry.
Array of all created pair addresses.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization and factory/token identity.
Miner-influenceable block timestamp used in permit deadline and TWAP accounting.
External approve: sets allowance for msg.sender via _approve.
External transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender via _transfer.
External transferFrom: decrements allowance unless infinite, then transfers.
EIP-2612 permit: verifies signature with ecrecover and sets allowance.
Internal helper writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Internal helper moving balances and emitting Transfer.
Internal mint: increases totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal burn: decreases sender balance and totalSupply.
View returning cached reserves and last update timestamp.
Private helper performing a low-level token transfer call with success checks.
One-time initializer setting token0/token1, callable only by the factory.
Updates reserves and TWAP price accumulators using block.timestamp arithmetic.
Mints protocol fee liquidity based on sqrt(k) growth when feeOn.
Liquidity provision entry point: computes amounts, mints LP tokens, updates reserves.
Liquidity removal entry point: burns LP tokens and transfers underlying assets.
Swap entry point: optimistically transfers outputs, calls callback, then verifies K invariant.
Transfers excess token balances above reserves to a recipient.
Forces reserves to match current token balances.
Sets factory to msg.sender at deployment.
Creates a new pair via create2 and registers it in getPair/allPairs.
Privileged setter for feeTo, restricted to feeToSetter.
Privileged setter for feeToSetter, restricted to current feeToSetter.
Sets initial feeToSetter from the constructor argument.
View returning the number of deployed pairs.
ecrecover signature recovery in permit; malleable signatures granting approvals.
Low-level token.call in _safeTransfer; arbitrary external call that can re-enter the pair.
External callback IBoxswapV2Callee(to).uniswapV2Call executed during swap; classic reentrancy vector.
Assembly create2 deployment of pair bytecode with caller-influenced salt inputs.
Unchecked uint32 timestamp subtraction in _update (overflow intentionally desired).
Unchecked multiplication/addition of TWAP price accumulators in _update.
Unchecked multiplication of adjusted balances enforcing the K invariant in swap.
owner parameter of permit, the account whose approval is signed.
spender parameter of permit, the approved spender address.
value parameter of permit, the approved allowance amount.
deadline parameter of permit, compared against block.timestamp.
digest local in permit, the EIP-712 hash passed to ecrecover.
recoveredAddress local in permit, signer recovered from ecrecover.
to parameter of swap, recipient of the output tokens and callback target.
data parameter of swap, calldata forwarded to the flash-swap callback.
amount0Out parameter of swap, token0 amount sent out.
amount1Out parameter of swap, token1 amount sent out.
amount0In local in swap, derived token0 input amount.
amount1In local in swap, derived token1 input amount.
token parameter of _safeTransfer, the contract targeted by the low-level call.
to parameter of _safeTransfer, transfer recipient.
value parameter of _safeTransfer, transfer amount.
blockTimestamp local in _update, truncated block.timestamp.
timeElapsed local in _update, unchecked timestamp delta.
tokenA parameter of createPair, one of the two pair tokens.
tokenB parameter of createPair, the other pair token.
bytecode local in createPair, pair creation code deployed via create2.
salt local in createPair, keccak of the sorted token addresses.
to parameter of mint, recipient of newly minted LP tokens.
to parameter of burn, recipient of withdrawn underlying tokens.
_token0 parameter of initialize, stored into token0.
_token1 parameter of initialize, stored into token1.

edges.reason: _mint increases the totalSupply state variable.
_burn decreases the totalSupply state variable.
_transfer reads and writes balanceOf balances.
transferFrom moves balances through _transfer and allowance.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
permit reads and increments nonces[owner] in the signature digest.
permit uses DOMAIN_SEPARATOR inside the EIP-712 digest.
initialize requires msg.sender to equal the factory state variable.
_mintFee queries feeTo through the factory address.
swap reads token0 for output transfers and recipient checks.
swap reads token1 for output transfers and recipient checks.
_update writes reserve0 from the measured balance.
_update writes reserve1 from the measured balance.
_update reads blockTimestampLast to compute timeElapsed.
_update accumulates into price0CumulativeLast.
_mintFee reads kLast to compute sqrt(k) growth.
lock modifier checks and toggles unlocked around swap.
_mintFee reads feeTo to decide whether fees are on.
setFeeTo requires msg.sender to equal feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter requires msg.sender to equal feeToSetter.
createPair checks and writes the getPair registry.
createPair pushes the new pair into allPairs.
pair constructor assigns factory = msg.sender.
initialize authorizes the caller against the factory address.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender in the allowance lookup.
approve sets allowance for msg.sender as owner.
transfer moves balances from msg.sender.
setFeeTo authorization relies on msg.sender.
setFeeToSetter authorization relies on msg.sender.
permit compares deadline against block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
_update uses block.timestamp for TWAP accounting, making pricing timestamp dependent.
the unchecked uint32 arithmetic is derived from block.timestamp.
approve delegates to _approve.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
permit builds the digest and invokes ecrecover.
permit calls _approve after signature verification.
_safeTransfer performs the low-level token call.
swap calls _safeTransfer to send output tokens.
burn calls _safeTransfer for both underlying tokens.
skim calls _safeTransfer to move excess balances.
the low-level token call can re-enter swap before reserves are updated.
swap invokes uniswapV2Call on the recipient, allowing arbitrary reentrancy.
caller-supplied data is forwarded to the uniswapV2Call callback.
swap reads current reserves via getReserves.
mint reads current reserves via getReserves.
burn reads current reserves via getReserves.
mint calls _mintFee before minting liquidity.
burn calls _mintFee before burning liquidity.
_mintFee mints fee liquidity through _mint.
mint mints LP tokens through _mint.
burn destroys LP tokens through _burn.
mint updates reserves via _update.
burn updates reserves via _update.
swap updates reserves via _update after the invariant check.
sync calls _update with the live token balances.
createPair deploys the pair contract via create2 assembly.
createPair initializes the freshly deployed pair.
factory constructor writes feeToSetter.
setFeeTo writes the feeTo state variable.
setFeeToSetter writes the feeToSetter state variable.
the uint32 timestamp subtraction in _update is unchecked and may overflow.
price accumulator multiply and add are unchecked arithmetic.
the K invariant check uses unchecked multiplication of adjusted balances.

recoveredAddress is compared against owner inside permit.

the data parameter decides whether the callback branch is taken.
amount0Out controls the token0 output amount.
amount1Out controls the token1 output amount.
amount0Out is forwarded into _safeTransfer.
amount1Out is forwarded into _safeTransfer.
amount0In feeds the adjusted balance used in the K check.
amount1In feeds the adjusted balance used in the K check.
the token parameter selects the contract that _safeTransfer calls.
the token parameter is the target of the low-level call.
the to parameter is the transfer recipient of _safeTransfer.
the value parameter is the transfer amount of _safeTransfer.
the blockTimestamp local is used in the unchecked subtraction.
timeElapsed scales the unchecked price accumulator update.
tokenA parameter helped select the pair tokens.
tokenB parameter helped select the pair tokens.
the bytecode local is passed to the create2 assembly deployment.
the salt local determines the create2 address.
the to parameter receives the newly minted LP tokens.
the to parameter receives the withdrawn underlying tokens.
_token0 parameter is consumed by initialize.
_token1 parameter is consumed by initialize.
initialize writes token0 from the _token0 parameter.
initialize writes token1 from the _token1 parameter.
